metaTitle: Custom Tri Blend Golf Polo Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom tri blend golf polo shirts for your team or event. Soft, breathable fabric with your logo. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Tri blend fabric combines polyester, cotton, and rayon for a soft, breathable feel that moves with you on the course. These custom tri blend golf polo shirts resist wrinkles and fading, making them a practical choice for corporate tournaments, employee uniforms, or giveaways. The jersey knit finish accepts embroidery or screen printing cleanly, so your logo stays sharp. Choose tri blend for a polished look that your team will actually want to wear.
